hook_text: Seven stickers, one giant map of South Africa. Can you put each one in the right place?
clip_script: Gqeberha, above Algoa Bay. A giant floor map and a sheet of stickers. Table Mountain, with its tablecloth cloud, in the Western Cape. The uKhahlamba-Drakensberg, along Lesotho. The Waterberg in Limpopo. Lake St Lucia, where river meets sea, in KwaZulu-Natal. Augrabies Falls, the place of great noise, on the Gariep. Cape Point, at the tip of the peninsula. And Algoa Bay, right here. Every province has its own features.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa on a classroom floor, with stickers dropping into place on each feature.
mood: Lively and challenging, like a map game with friends.
pacing: One sticker per beat, snapping into place, then a slow zoom to your own province.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a map of the physical features of your own province.
